note: Camera marks for the Episode-1 opening (beats B1-B6). M1..M5 are the kitchen marks (kitchen/src/cameraMarks.js) used as-is unless overridden here; M_swing is the mid-whip waypoint; M7 is re-tuned for the 3D title. `speed` scales the spline tangent at that knot (0 = stop, 1 = pass-through): it is never 0, so the camera never comes to rest between beats.

M_swing.note: mid whip-orbit waypoint on Panda's right: his back is still to us while he spins

M7_title_lift.note: wide enough for the whole one-line title; the kitchen M7 was too tight for 25 letters

portrait.note: below this aspect the 3D title is hidden and the flat HTML title (built around the 3D knife stem) is shown
